Claims checked:
(1) A4: checkReplace judges the floor on addedDenies(stored, body less drops) only. An id the packs no longer hold is tolerated only when the stored document names it, in any spelling and in either list of its kind. StaleIds.drop then drops it and reports it in Written.dropped. An id never named is still unknown_artifact 422 (aPutStillRefusesAnUnknownIdTheStoredDocumentNeverNamed). This follows DM-01M6RA7XC5HC8915GZT2R3H83W ("ids the packs no longer hold"). Create (POST) still judges everything.
(2) PUT without If-Match: the contract allows it (replaceActivation: "without it the write is last-writer-wins", ADR-0020 D6). The loop is bounded (8 attempts). Each attempt re-reads, re-judges, then CAS-writes at the read revision, so the final write is still last-writer-wins. A Missing or Stale result re-reads, so a create racing a delete is handled. Not sharing the tryLock mechanism is right: the lock lives inside FileActivationRepository (infra), and the domain port offers only find/create/CAS. The per-artifact writes use the same CAS pattern. The race test was written after the code, so it has no red evidence, but it is real: a mutation to LATEST_ATTEMPTS=1 fails aPutWithoutAValidatorIsJudgedAgainstTheDocumentAnotherWriterStoredInBetween, and a judge-once unconditional write would pass the refused deny. Non-blocking: when all 8 attempts fail, a request with no If-Match gets 412, which the contract does not describe. Exhaustion is not tested.
(3) B1: StaleIds drops a pin no pack holds; the pack stays, unpinned. The pin is reported in droppedPins. A write that only drops a pin is not a no-op (b1AWriteThatDropsOnlyAPinIsNoNoOp, new revision). Create keeps version_not_held (DM-01M6RN5Y406SB4KA13QYMQ2P8J; pair tested in DocumentRulesTest and ActivationServiceTest). ActivationChange.droppedPins is declared, required (WP01).
(4) T018: ActivationWrites.selectable and deniable take any activatable kind, and declared() no longer matches a mission type exactly (a7-codeshape rows 21-22, class a; this also aligns the path with the body, as the WP03 review asked). mission_type_not_found 404 is kept. The split with WP05 holds: a required or locked mission type is already 409 through the floor, and a non-floor mission-type deny stays in CascadeRules.requireDeniable, which is WP05 T022.
(5) Out-of-map rewrites in WP05-owned tests (recorded in the commit). Each pins a ruled change and is not weakened. aMissionTypePathIdIsMatchedExactly is now any spelling, with a 404 negative control. aPinnedVersion...StillNotDropped is now dropped and reported, with an added no-op test. The ExclusionService /kind 422 test is now accepted at the path, with 409, 404 and spelling-insensitive reactivate. WP05 has no commits on these files yet, but expect a merge touch.
